prompt: What city does the band whose song spent the most weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot Rock & Alternative Songs chart as of August 1, 2024 originate from?
answer: The band was **Glass Animals**, whose song **“Heat Waves”** spent a record **34 weeks at No. 1** on Billboard’s Hot Rock & Alternative Songs chart as of August 1, 2024. The band originated in **Oxford, England**.
